_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Validation Completion Report
summary: The Validation Completion Report provides certification that contractor validation of technical manuals has been accomplished.
use_relationship:
The Validation Completion Report provides certification that contractor validation of technical manuals has been accomplished.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for data generated under the work task described in the contract and Appendix D of NSA DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of COMSEC Technical Manuals, current edition, is available at the National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6718; Attn: I5222.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Validation Completion Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor shall provide a report for each technical manual in accordance with Appendix D of NSA DS-56.
